ledgerRelationship: The sealed GitHub ledger is retained unchanged as harness-scope evidence. Its excerpts do not substantiate the paper-derived statistical claims; this sidecar makes that evidence visible rather than relabeling the sealed evidence.

sources.title: tau-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
sources.finding: Defines pass^k as all k i.i.d. task trials succeeding, averaged across tasks. Main results use at least three trials; fixed task prompt and database transitions coexist with stochastic user and agent messages. The authors also note that final-state reward need not capture all policy violations.
sources.application: Borrow repeated-trial reliability and fixed-context execution; do not adopt the task-completion endpoint or claim fixed seeds make agent runs identical.

sources.title: Agreement among statistical significance tests for information retrieval evaluation at varying sample sizes
sources.finding: Smucker, Allan, and Carterette compare TREC runs with topic counts from 10 to 50. Test disagreement increases as topic count decreases; bootstrap p-values show a systematic downward bias relative to t-test, increasing at smaller samples. They recommend the randomization test, while noting that t-test appears suitable for these experiments.
sources.application: Use paired randomization as primary significance evidence and task-clustered bootstrap as an effect-size interval; do not treat a bootstrap interval alone as an exact small-sample test.

sources.title: SWE-rebench: An Automated Pipeline for Task Collection and Decontaminated Evaluation of Software Engineering Agents
sources.finding: Uses a fixed scaffold and five full-benchmark runs, reporting SEM and pass@5 rather than best-run performance. Tracks task creation dates and model release dates to mark potentially contaminated evaluations; explicitly does not prove absence from training data.
sources.application: Fix scaffold and disclose variation. Record task provenance and timing; use independent annotation to reduce selection leakage without promising contamination-free evaluation.

sources.title: Coding Agents are Effective Long-Context Processors
sources.finding: Reports BrowseComp-Plus native search means of 14.92 without a retriever, 9.84 with BM25, and 8.33 with Gemini Embeddings. Retrieval does not consistently improve correctness, and the authors explicitly leave the precise mechanism open; their configurations also vary tool availability and instructions.
sources.application: Supports treating native Read/Grep as a behavioral endpoint with a correctness guardrail, not as a correctness surrogate or proof of the causal mechanism.

sources.title: Adaptive Retrieval helps Reasoning in LLMs -- but mostly if it is not used
sources.finding: Observes worse performance in traces with retrieved results and better performance in adaptive traces without retrieval than CoT, framing selective retrieval as a metacognitive signal. This is motivation to test an action-versus-content confound, not proof that reflection is the mediator.
sources.application: Include a same-candidates rank-destruction control as a diagnostic; explicitly do not claim complete causal mediation identification.

sources.title: Baseline: Agent Sufficiency v1
sources.finding: Requires reduction of fallback reads while preserving legitimate deepening, edit preparation, and verification; zero Read is not the goal.
sources.application: The primary endpoint must be audited recovery Read/Grep, not raw Read/Grep counts.

sources.title: Interactive agent evaluation harness
sources.finding: Drives interactive Claude Code in tmux. Its comments distinguish interactive subagent behavior from headless print-mode.
sources.application: Reuse this execution surface after adding single-variable arm switching and deterministic run manifests; do not silently substitute headless mode.

sources.title: Raw agent arm trace parser
sources.finding: Counts raw Read, Grep, and Glob calls and successful result envelopes. It has no fallback/deepening/edit-preparation/verification classifier.
sources.application: The audited endpoint and blinded annotation are unimplemented prerequisites.

sources.title: Bounded reranking and independent agent value gate
sources.url: docs/decisions/ZJ-0013-bounded-reranking-and-independent-agent-value-gate.md#d5--agent-净收益采用配对验证不能用离线指标替代
sources.finding: Requires task-by-repetition pairs, interleaved arms, retained failures, audited fallback reduction, correctness non-regression, and paired bootstrap intervals with zero crossing classified inconclusive.
sources.application: ZRA-Paired inherits the intent but proposes task-clustered bootstrap plus randomization inference; the precise amendment must be accepted before use.

sources.title: Split retrieval gate into Agent entry and ship
sources.finding: Approves C only for opt-in paired Agent evaluation, requires a task set independent of v3, and preserves strict G-ship criteria.
sources.application: The report cannot unlock 1-4 or change product defaults; a successful experiment only permits separately gated substantiation.

designInferences.text: For each task and arm, average the valid repeated-run recovery counts. For C versus A, compute d_i=mean(A_i)-mean(C_i), so positive values favor C. Randomly flip the signs of d_i within each task for the paired randomization test; resample whole tasks, not task-by-trial rows, for the confidence interval.

Within every task, use six repetitions to cover all A/C/S orders once, randomized independently by task. If k=4 is retained for cost, use a balanced subset of the six orders and record the uncovered orders; do not call ABBA a three-arm design.

S preserves C's exact candidate set, count, payload schema, and content bytes; a recorded permutation destroys the association between rank and relevance. It is diagnostic of ranking value versus retrieval-action effects, not a complete reflection-versus-content mediator test.

Use 5-8 tasks x 4 trials/arm only for pilot variance, order effects, annotation reliability, missingness, and cost. Before confirmatory runs, choose MDE and target power; a normal approximation starting point is N=ceil(2*(1.96+0.84)^2*s_d^2/MDE^2) independent tasks, followed by a paired randomization simulation using the pilot distribution. Proposed alpha=0.05 two-sided, power=0.80, MDE=1.5 recovery calls/task are not results or an approved fixed N.
